events.description: Called with the new value each time the user changes it.
events.name: onChange

events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

events.description: Handler that is called when the element loses focus.
events.name: onBlur

events.description: Handler that is called when the element receives focus.
events.name: onFocus

events.description: Handler that is called when the element's focus status changes.
events.name: onFocusChange

events.description: Handler that is called when a key is pressed.
events.name: onKeyDown

events.description: Handler that is called when a key is released.
events.name: onKeyUp

props.description: The look of the field. Defaults to `primary`.
props.name: variant

props.description: True to fill the parent's width. Defaults to true.
props.name: isFullWidth

props.description: The earliest moment accepted.
props.name: minValue

props.description: The latest moment accepted.
props.name: maxValue

props.description: 12 or 24 hours; defaults to the locale's.
props.name: hourCycle

props.description: The calendar the day is shown in; defaults to `gregory`. The value stays Gregorian.
props.name: calendar

props.description: The spoken name of the button that opens the calendar; defaults to the `ui` catalogue's phrase.
props.name: calendarButtonLabel

props.description: The visible label; it is the field's accessible name, so a field without one needs the runtime's own name prop.
props.name: label

props.description: Help text under the field, tied to it for assistive technology.
props.name: description

props.description: What is wrong, shown under the field while `isInvalid` is true, and read out with the field.
props.name: errorMessage

props.description: True when the form cannot be submitted without a value; the label shows it and assistive technology is told.
props.name: isRequired

props.description: True to show the error state; the field alone never decides, so a form adapter sets it from its validation.
props.name: isInvalid

props.description: True to refuse input and show the disabled style; the field leaves the tab order and is left out of the submit.
props.name: isDisabled

props.description: True to show the value but refuse changes; unlike disabled, the field keeps focus and is submitted.
props.name: isReadOnly

props.description: The current value, for a controlled field; pair it with `onChange`.
props.name: value

props.description: The starting value, for an uncontrolled field.
props.name: defaultValue

props.description: The name the value is submitted under in a form, and the key a form adapter binds.
props.name: name

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen

props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.
props.name: aria-describedby

props.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the
object.
props.name: aria-details

props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.
props.name: aria-labelledby

props.description:
Describes the type of autocomplete functionality the input should provide if any. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input#htmlattrdefautocomplete).
props.name: autoComplete

props.description: Whether the element should receive focus on render.
props.name: autoFocus

props.description:
The CSS [className](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/className) for the
element. A function may be provided to compute the class based on component state.
props.name: className

props.description: The day that starts the week.
props.name: firstDayOfWeek

props.description:
The `<form>` element to associate the input with.
The value of this attribute must be the id of a `<form>` in the same document.
See [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/input#form).
props.name: form

props.description: Whether to hide the time zone abbreviation.
props.name: hideTimeZone

props.description:
The element's unique identifier. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/id).
props.name: id

props.description:
Callback that is called for each date of the calendar. If it returns true, then the date is
unavailable.
props.name: isDateUnavailable

props.description:
Controls the behavior of paging. Pagination either works by advancing the visible page by
visibleDuration (default) or one unit of visibleDuration.
props.name: pageBehavior

props.description:
A placeholder date that influences the format of the placeholder shown when no value is
selected. Defaults to today's date at midnight.
props.name: placeholderValue

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref

props.description:
Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
This allows rendering existing components with built-in styles and behaviors
such as router links, animation libraries, and pre-styled components.

Requirements:

- You must render the expected element type (e.g. if `<button>` is expected, you cannot render an
  `<a>`).
- Only a single root DOM element can be rendered (no fragments).
- You must pass through props and ref to the underlying DOM element, merging with your own prop
  as appropriate.
props.name: render

props.description: Determines whether the date picker popover should close automatically when a date is selected.
props.name: shouldCloseOnSelect

props.description:
Whether to always show leading zeros in the month, day, and hour fields.
By default, this is determined by the user's locale.
props.name: shouldForceLeadingZeros

props.description:
A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.
props.name: slot

props.description:
The inline [style](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/style) for the
element. A function may be provided to compute the style based on component state.
props.name: style

props.description:
A function that returns an error message if a given value is invalid.
Validation errors are displayed to the user when the form is submitted
if `validationBehavior="native"`. For realtime validation, use the `isInvalid`
prop instead.
props.name: validate

props.description:
Whether to use native HTML form validation to prevent form submission
when the value is missing or invalid, or mark the field as required
or invalid via ARIA.
props.name: validationBehavior
